archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉｄｅａｌｓ　ｐｒｏｂａｂｌｙ　ｃａｎｎｏｔ　ｏｖｅｒｔｕｒｎ　ｒｅａｌｉｔｙ，　ｂｕｔ．．．

archived_logical_changes.text: If believing that gives you strength, I will not deny it.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉｆ　ｂｅｌｉｅｖｉｎｇ　ｔｈａｔ　ｇｉｖｅｓ　ｙｏｕ　ｓｔｒｅｎｇｔｈ，　Ｉ　ｗｉｌｌ　ｎｏｔ　ｄｅｎｙ　ｉｔ．

archived_logical_changes.text: And I do not dislike that way of thinking of yours.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ａｎｄ　Ｉ　ｄｏ　ｎｏｔ　ｄｉｓｌｉｋｅ　ｔｈａｔ　ｗａｙ　ｏｆ　ｔｈｉｎｋｉｎｇ　ｏｆ　ｙｏｕｒｓ．

archived_logical_changes.text: So Galeor can get up now...
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｓｏ　Ｇａｌｅｏｒ　ｃａｎ　ｇｅｔ　ｕｐ　ｎｏｗ．．．

archived_logical_changes.text: I see. Galeor can get up now...
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ　ｓｅｅ．　Ｇａｌｅｏｒ　ｃａｎ　ｇｅｔ　ｕｐ　ｎｏｗ．．．

archived_logical_changes.text: His recovery is remarkable. Frankly, I am surprised.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｈｉｓ　ｒｅｃｏｖｅｒｙ　ｉｓ　ｒｅｍａｒｋａｂｌｅ．　Ｆｒａｎｋｌｙ，　Ｉ　ａｍ　ｓｕｒｐｒｉｓｅｄ．

archived_logical_changes.text: Though when I say he has recovered, I only mean enough for daily life.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｔｈｏｕｇｈ　ｗｈｅｎ　Ｉ　ｓａｙ　ｈｅ　ｈａｓ　ｒｅｃｏｖｅｒｅｄ，　Ｉ　ｏｎｌｙ　ｍｅａｎ　ｅｎｏｕｇｈ　ｆｏｒ　ｄａｉｌｙ　ｌｉｆｅ．

archived_logical_changes.text: He won't be able to fight for some time.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｈｅ　ｗｏｎ’ｔ　ｂｅ　ａｂｌｅ　ｔｏ　ｆｉｇｈｔ　ｆｏｒ　ｓｏｍｅ　ｔｉｍｅ．

archived_logical_changes.text: Of course, that is only because his attacker held back...
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｏｆ　ｃｏｕｒｓｅ，　ｔｈａｔ　ｉｓ　ｏｎｌｙ　ｂｅｃａｕｓｅ　ｈｉｓ　ａｔｔａｃｋｅｒ　ｈｅｌｄ　ｂａｃｋ．．．

archived_logical_changes.text: His wounds show signs that fatal damage was deliberately avoided.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｈｉｓ　ｗｏｕｎｄｓ　ｓｈｏｗ　ｓｉｇｎｓ　ｔｈａｔ　ｆａｔａｌ　ｄａｍａｇｅ　ｗａｓ　ｄｅｌｉｂｅｒａｔｅｌｙ　ａｖｏｉｄｅｄ．

archived_logical_changes.text: It may only be coincidence, but...
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉｔ　ｍａｙ　ｏｎｌｙ　ｂｅ　ｃｏｉｎｃｉｄｅｎｃｅ，　ｂｕｔ．．．

archived_logical_changes.text: It is too much of a coincidence, isn't it?
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉｔ　ｉｓ　ｔｏｏ　ｍｕｃｈ　ｏｆ　ａ　ｃｏｉｎｃｉｄｅｎｃｅ，　ｉｓｎ’ｔ　ｉｔ？

archived_logical_changes.text: I officially permit you to visit the patients.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ　ｏｆｆｉｃｉａｌｌｙ　ｐｅｒｍｉｔ　ｙｏｕ　ｔｏ　ｖｉｓｉｔ　ｔｈｅ　ｐａｔｉｅｎｔｓ．

archived_logical_changes.text: It would help if you spoke to them once and explained the situation.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉｔ　ｗｏｕｌｄ　ｈｅｌｐ　ｉｆ　ｙｏｕ　ｓｐｏｋｅ　ｔｏ　ｔｈｅｍ　ｏｎｃｅ　ａｎｄ　ｅｘｐｌａｉｎｅｄ　ｔｈｅ　ｓｉｔｕａｔｉｏｎ．

archived_logical_changes.text: I have no reason to accept your concern...
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ　ｈａｖｅ　ｎｏ　ｒｅａｓｏｎ　ｔｏ　ａｃｃｅｐｔ　ｙｏｕｒ　ｃｏｎｃｅｒｎ．．．

archived_logical_changes.text: I expected it, but it looks like he really hates me.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ　ｅｘｐｅｃｔｅｄ　ｉｔ，　ｂｕｔ　ｉｔ　ｌｏｏｋｓ　ｌｉｋｅ　ｈｅ　ｒｅａｌｌｙ　ｈａｔｅｓ　ｍｅ．

archived_logical_changes.text: I expected it, but it seems he really hates me.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ　ｅｘｐｅｃｔｅｄ　ｉｔ，　ｂｕｔ　ｉｔ　ｓｅｅｍｓ　ｈｅ　ｒｅａｌｌｙ　ｈａｔｅｓ　ｍｅ．

archived_logical_changes.text: I'm sorry... I know you saved us, but...
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ’ｍ　ｓｏｒｒｙ．．．　Ｉ　ｋｎｏｗ　ｙｏｕ　ｓａｖｅｄ　ｕｓ，　ｂｕｔ．．．

archived_logical_changes.text: Neither he nor I can simply put it behind us.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｎｅｉｔｈｅｒ　ｈｅ　ｎｏｒ　Ｉ　ｃａｎ　ｓｉｍｐｌｙ　ｐｕｔ　ｉｔ　ｂｅｈｉｎｄ　ｕｓ．

archived_logical_changes.text: Don't worry about it. I didn't do it to make you indebted to me.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｄｏｎ’ｔ　ｗｏｒｒｙ　ａｂｏｕｔ　ｉｔ．　Ｉ　ｄｉｄｎ’ｔ　ｄｏ　ｉｔ　ｔｏ　ｍａｋｅ　ｙｏｕ　ｉｎｄｅｂｔｅｄ　ｔｏ　ｍｅ．

archived_logical_changes.text: Please don't worry about it. I didn't do it to make you indebted to me.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｐｌｅａｓｅ　ｄｏｎ’ｔ　ｗｏｒｒｙ　ａｂｏｕｔ　ｉｔ．　Ｉ　ｄｉｄｎ’ｔ　ｄｏ　ｉｔ　ｔｏ　ｍａｋｅ　ｙｏｕ　ｉｎｄｅｂｔｅｄ　ｔｏ　ｍｅ．

archived_logical_changes.text: Thanks to that girl's nursing, he is recovering steadily.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｔｈａｎｋｓ　ｔｏ　ｔｈａｔ　ｇｉｒｌ’ｓ　ｎｕｒｓｉｎｇ，　ｈｅ　ｉｓ　ｒｅｃｏｖｅｒｉｎｇ　ｓｔｅａｄｉｌｙ．

archived_logical_changes.text: It's hard to believe he kept deliriously repeating, 'I can't go on.'
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉｔ’ｓ　ｈａｒｄ　ｔｏ　ｂｅｌｉｅｖｅ　ｈｅ　ｋｅｐｔ　ｄｅｌｉｒｉｏｕｓｌｙ　ｒｅｐｅａｔｉｎｇ，　’Ｉ　ｃａｎ’ｔ　ｇｏ　ｏｎ．’

archived_logical_changes.text: You came to talk about what happens from here, didn't you?
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｙｏｕ　ｃａｍｅ　ｔｏ　ｔａｌｋ　ａｂｏｕｔ　ｗｈａｔ　ｈａｐｐｅｎｓ　ｆｒｏｍ　ｈｅｒｅ，　ｄｉｄｎ’ｔ　ｙｏｕ？

archived_logical_changes.text: Sit there and wait for me.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｓｉｔ　ｔｈｅｒｅ　ａｎｄ　ｗａｉｔ　ｆｏｒ　ｍｅ．

archived_logical_changes.text: This may take a while, so I'll prepare some tea.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｔｈｉｓ　ｍａｙ　ｔａｋｅ　ａ　ｗｈｉｌｅ，　ｓｏ　Ｉ’ｌｌ　ｐｒｅｐａｒｅ　ｓｏｍｅ　ｔｅａ．

archived_logical_changes.text: I cannot let the Captain do such chores... Ngh!?
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ　ｃａｎｎｏｔ　ｌｅｔ　ｔｈｅ　Ｃａｐｔａｉｎ　ｄｏ　ｓｕｃｈ　ｃｈｏｒｅｓ．．．　Ｎｇｈ！？

archived_logical_changes.text: The injured should be quiet and lie down. That is an order.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｔｈｅ　ｉｎｊｕｒｅｄ　ｓｈｏｕｌｄ　ｂｅ　ｑｕｉｅｔ　ａｎｄ　ｌｉｅ　ｄｏｗｎ．　Ｔｈａｔ　ｉｓ　ａｎ　ｏｒｄｅｒ．

archived_logical_changes.text: It is somehow hard to start talking to him.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉｔ　ｉｓ　ｓｏｍｅｈｏｗ　ｈａｒｄ　ｔｏ　ｓｔａｒｔ　ｔａｌｋｉｎｇ　ｔｏ　ｈｉｍ．

archived_logical_changes.text: Back then, I thought I would not mind dying like that.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｂａｃｋ　ｔｈｅｎ，　Ｉ　ｔｈｏｕｇｈｔ　Ｉ　ｗｏｕｌｄ　ｎｏｔ　ｍｉｎｄ　ｄｙｉｎｇ　ｌｉｋｅ　ｔｈａｔ．

archived_logical_changes.text: My brother betrayed me, and the unit I had struggled to hold together was destroyed.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｍｙ　ｂｒｏｔｈｅｒ　ｂｅｔｒａｙｅｄ　ｍｅ，　ａｎｄ　ｔｈｅ　ｕｎｉｔ　Ｉ　ｈａｄ　ｓｔｒｕｇｇｌｅｄ　ｔｏ　ｈｏｌｄ　ｔｏｇｅｔｈｅｒ　ｗａｓ　ｄｅｓｔｒｏｙｅｄ．

archived_logical_changes.text: If I could have dealt even one blow to that man's anger and grief,
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉｆ　Ｉ　ｃｏｕｌｄ　ｈａｖｅ　ｄｅａｌｔ　ｅｖｅｎ　ｏｎｅ　ｂｌｏｗ　ｔｏ　ｔｈａｔ　ｍａｎ’ｓ　ａｎｇｅｒ　ａｎｄ　ｇｒｉｅｆ，

archived_logical_changes.text: then I would have had no regrets about dying.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: ｔｈｅｎ　Ｉ　ｗｏｕｌｄ　ｈａｖｅ　ｈａｄ　ｎｏ　ｒｅｇｒｅｔｓ　ａｂｏｕｔ　ｄｙｉｎｇ．

archived_logical_changes.text: Unlike that person and you, I never graduated from a military academy.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｕｎｌｉｋｅ　ｔｈａｔ　ｐｅｒｓｏｎ　ａｎｄ　ｙｏｕ，　Ｉ　ｎｅｖｅｒ　ｇｒａｄｕａｔｅｄ　ｆｒｏｍ　ａ　ｍｉｌｉｔａｒｙ　ａｃａｄｅｍｙ．

archived_logical_changes.text: I was conscripted in the field, a career soldier who survived only by fighting strength.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ　ｗａｓ　ｃｏｎｓｃｒｉｐｔｅｄ　ｉｎ　ｔｈｅ　ｆｉｅｌｄ，　ａ　ｃａｒｅｅｒ　ｓｏｌｄｉｅｒ　ｗｈｏ　ｓｕｒｖｉｖｅｄ　ｏｎｌｙ　ｂｙ　ｆｉｇｈｔｉｎｇ　ｓｔｒｅｎｇｔｈ．

archived_logical_changes.text: The Sixth Unit was a collection of troublesome people like me, and delinquents who broke military discipline.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｔｈｅ　Ｓｉｘｔｈ　Ｕｎｉｔ　ｗａｓ　ａ　ｃｏｌｌｅｃｔｉｏｎ　ｏｆ　ｔｒｏｕｂｌｅｓｏｍｅ　ｐｅｏｐｌｅ　ｌｉｋｅ　ｍｅ，　ａｎｄ　ｄｅｌｉｎｑｕｅｎｔｓ　ｗｈｏ　ｂｒｏｋｅ　ｍｉｌｉｔａｒｙ　ｄｉｓｃｉｐｌｉｎｅ．

archived_logical_changes.text: That is what the Sixth Unit really was.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｔｈａｔ　ｉｓ　ｗｈａｔ　ｔｈｅ　Ｓｉｘｔｈ　Ｕｎｉｔ　ｒｅａｌｌｙ　ｗａｓ．

archived_logical_changes.text: It was the brass's harassment of a capable woman soldier.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉｔ　ｗａｓ　ｔｈｅ　ｂｒａｓｓ’ｓ　ｈａｒａｓｓｍｅｎｔ　ｏｆ　ａ　ｃａｐａｂｌｅ　ｗｏｍａｎ　ｓｏｌｄｉｅｒ．

archived_logical_changes.text: Even so, she never looked down on us.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｅｖｅｎ　ｓｏ，　ｓｈｅ　ｎｅｖｅｒ　ｌｏｏｋｅｄ　ｄｏｗｎ　ｏｎ　ｕｓ．

archived_logical_changes.text: She led by example, built trust, and made us into a proper unit.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｓｈｅ　ｌｅｄ　ｂｙ　ｅｘａｍｐｌｅ，　ｂｕｉｌｔ　ｔｒｕｓｔ，　ａｎｄ　ｍａｄｅ　ｕｓ　ｉｎｔｏ　ａ　ｐｒｏｐｅｒ　ｕｎｉｔ．

archived_logical_changes.text: I want to repay a captain like her...
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ　ｗａｎｔ　ｔｏ　ｒｅｐａｙ　ａ　ｃａｐｔａｉｎ　ｌｉｋｅ　ｈｅｒ．．．

archived_logical_changes.text: But with this body, I cannot do even that.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｂｕｔ　ｗｉｔｈ　ｔｈｉｓ　ｂｏｄｙ，　Ｉ　ｃａｎｎｏｔ　ｄｏ　ｅｖｅｎ　ｔｈａｔ．

archived_logical_changes.text: So please! Lend me the strength of your sword!
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｓｏ　ｐｌｅａｓｅ！　Ｌｅｎｄ　ｍｅ　ｔｈｅ　ｓｔｒｅｎｇｔｈ　ｏｆ　ｙｏｕｒ　ｓｗｏｒｄ！

archived_logical_changes.text: I want to ease my subordinates' resentment and the Captain's suffering.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ　ｗａｎｔ　ｔｏ　ｅａｓｅ　ｍｙ　ｓｕｂｏｒｄｉｎａｔｅｓ’　ｒｅｓｅｎｔｍｅｎｔ　ａｎｄ　ｔｈｅ　Ｃａｐｔａｉｎ’ｓ　ｓｕｆｆｅｒｉｎｇ．

archived_logical_changes.text: Azlier really was a captain her people adored.

archived_logical_changes.text: Azlier really was a captain her people adored.

archived_logical_changes.text: Galeor... Could it be that you love her...?
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｇａｌｅｏｒ．．．　Ｃｏｕｌｄ　ｉｔ　ｂｅ　ｔｈａｔ　ｙｏｕ　ｌｏｖｅ　ｈｅｒ．．．？

archived_logical_changes.text: I'm sorry. But it is enough for me to remain that person's lieutenant...
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ’ｍ　ｓｏｒｒｙ．　Ｂｕｔ　ｉｔ　ｉｓ　ｅｎｏｕｇｈ　ｆｏｒ　ｍｅ　ｔｏ　ｒｅｍａｉｎ　ｔｈａｔ　ｐｅｒｓｏｎ’ｓ　ｌｉｅｕｔｅｎａｎｔ．．．

archived_logical_changes.text: If I can support her, that is enough for me...
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉｆ　Ｉ　ｃａｎ　ｓｕｐｐｏｒｔ　ｈｅｒ，　ｔｈａｔ　ｉｓ　ｅｎｏｕｇｈ　ｆｏｒ　ｍｅ．．．

archived_logical_changes.text: I promise you, Galeor. I will never mistreat you or your people.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｉ　ｐｒｏｍｉｓｅ　ｙｏｕ，　Ｇａｌｅｏｒ．　Ｉ　ｗｉｌｌ　ｎｅｖｅｒ　ｍｉｓｔｒｅａｔ　ｙｏｕ　ｏｒ　ｙｏｕｒ　ｐｅｏｐｌｅ．

archived_logical_changes.text: Galeor, I promise you here: I will never mistreat you or your people.
archived_logical_changes.display_text: Ｇａｌｅｏｒ，　Ｉ　ｐｒｏｍｉｓｅ　ｙｏｕ　ｈｅｒｅ：　Ｉ　ｗｉｌｌ　ｎｅｖｅｒ　ｍｉｓｔｒｅａｔ　ｙｏｕ　ｏｒ　ｙｏｕｒ　ｐｅｏｐｌｅ．

archived_logical_changes.text: So lend me your strength now. It does not have to be for our sake.

archived_logical_changes.text: So please lend me your strength now. It does not have to be for our sake.

archived_logical_changes.text: To drive the Colorless Faction away.

archived_logical_changes.text: Until the Faction matter is settled, they agreed to leave you in my care.

archived_logical_changes.text: I have spoken properly with everyone on the island.
